copy.headline: Burleson police investigate possible road rage in deadly Thanksgiving crash
copy.caption:
Authorities in Burleson said road rage may have played a role in a Thanksgiving night crash that killed a 24-year-old woman. Police said the passenger of the truck died as a result of the crash.

The truck's driver, a 24-year-old man, and a minor in the back seat were taken to an area hospital.

story.title: Burleson police investigate possible road rage in deadly Thanksgiving crash
story.summary: Authorities in Burleson said road rage may have played a role in a Thanksgiving night crash that killed a 24-year-old woman. Authorities in Burleson said road rage may have played a role in a Thanksgiving night crash that killed a 24-year-old woman. Burleson police said the crash happened around 8 p.m. Thursday at the intersection of Renfro Street and Wilshire Boulevard when a truck ran a red light and collided with a vehicle that was going through the intersection legally. Police said the passenger of the truck died as a result of the crash. The truck's driver, a 24-year-old man, and a minor in the back seat were taken to an area hospital. The driver of the other vehicle was also taken to the hospital.
